label: TP
reason: User-supplied header value flows directly into bar via getHeaders->nextElement, undergoes URL decoding, then becomes input bytes which are converted back to a String and passed to encodeForHTML. The encoded HTML is concatenated into the HTTP response output stream without further sanitization, enabling XSS. The stack trace exposures are separate issues unrelated to the XSS path.

evidence.note: header param -> decode -> input -> encodeForHTML -> response output
